name: Post Matric Scholarship for students with Disabilities - DNH & DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu
benefit:
1. Scholarship support is available for studies from Class 11 up to Post-Graduate Degree or Diploma level.
1. Eligible courses should be approved by recognised bodies such as:

- University Grants Commission (UGC)
- National Medical Commission (NMC)
- Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI)
- All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
- State Government or Union Territory Government

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a student with a benchmark disability of 40% or more as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. 1. The applicant should possess a Unique Disability ID (UDID). 1. The applicant should possess an Aadhaar Card. 1. The applicant should pursue eligible Post-Matric educational courses covered under the scheme. 1. The applicant should satisfy the prescribed income ceiling criteria. 1. The applicant should study in Class 11 to Post-Graduate Degree or Diploma level. 1. The applicant should pursue courses approved by recognized bodies such as: - University Grants Commission (UGC) - State Government or Union Territory Government - National Medical Commission (NMC) - Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) - All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
